column1: # The manufacturer's published list price for each product family
# The page of every row was fetched and was seen to publish the price in
# schema.org `Product` markup. The price is the figure the manufacturer
# publishes for the whole family — the starting price
# one configuration — and it is recorded on the family.
# The same family in another market is listed in
# `data/regional-price-sources.csv`; those prices are recorded as regional
# observations and never overwrite the family's own price.
# The region and the currency have to agree. A page that publishes a
# different currency from the one declared here is believed
# difference is reported by the refresh.
